name: imagination-octo-engine
description: Experimental idea generation that preserves brief fit while producing a portfolio of causally different, non-obvious directions.

interface.longDescription: A concise experimental ideation skill that protects the user's non-negotiables, explores direct answers, remote causal mechanisms, and single-premise shifts, then privately proves each survivor before returning a small portfolio of genuinely different directions. Fit is a veto; randomness and strangeness are not goals by themselves. Runtime evaluation gates were removed and moved to an offline blind A/B harness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagination-octo-engine to generate several genuinely different ideas for this brief.
